startUrls.title: Workday career site URLs
startUrls.description: Career sites on Workday, one per line, e.g. https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite. A URL copied after choosing filters on the site (location, job category…) keeps those filters.

searchText.title: Search text
searchText.description: Keywords to search for on every site, as in the site's search box, e.g. python or data engineer. Leave empty for all jobs. A search in the URL (?q=) takes precedence.

includeDescription.title: Include job details
includeDescription.description: Load each job's page for the full description, exact posting date, apply deadline, country and time type. Turning this off is much faster, but the date is then approximate ("Posted 3 Days Ago").

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Keep only jobs posted in the last N days. 0 keeps all jobs.

splitBeyond2000.title: Get more than 2000 jobs per site
splitBeyond2000.description: Workday search returns at most 2000 jobs. When a site has more, split the search by the site's own filters (job category, location…) to reach every job.

maxJobsPerSite.title: Max jobs per site
maxJobsPerSite.description: Maximum number of jobs to return for each career site. 0 means no limit.

maxItems.title: Max jobs in total
maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to return in the whole run. You pay only for jobs that are saved.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy servers to use. Workday career sites work without a proxy.
